Endless Summer | Spacious 4BR Inlet Beach Retreat Near 30A

Welcome to Endless Summer, a comfortable coastal retreat in the heart of Inlet Beach, just minutes from Scenic Highway 30A and less than half a mile from the beach. With over 2,100 square feet of living space, this charming craftsman-style home is designed for easy family vacations, offering bright gathering spaces, spacious bedrooms, and great outdoor living.

Inside, the open-concept layout connects the living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen, creating a relaxed space to gather after a day at the beach. Out back, a brick patio with built-in benches and a fire pit provides the perfect setting for evening cookouts, with the propane grill located right on the patio.

Guests can easily walk or bike to Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, and a convenient pedestrian underpass beneath Highway 98 makes getting to the beach and nearby communities safe and simple.

The home also features a 240V NEMA outlet on a 50A circuit for EV charging.

Why Guests Love Endless Summer

• Prime Inlet Beach Location – Near Scenic 30A with quick access to restaurants, shops, and local attractions.
• Less Than ½ Mile to the Beach – Easy bike ride or short walk using the pedestrian underpass.
• Bikeable to 30A Communities – Conveniently located near Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach.
• Backyard Patio – Brick patio with built-in seating, fire pit, and grill for outdoor gatherings.
• Beach Gear Included – Backpack beach chairs, beach towels, umbrella, and a beach wagon make beach days easy.
• 4 Complimentary Beach Bikes – Perfect for cruising along 30A.
• EV Charging Available – 240V NEMA outlet on a dedicated 50A circuit.

Comfortable & Family-Friendly Layout

• Two King Suites – One on the first floor and one on the second floor, each with a private ensuite bathroom.
• Queen Guest Bedroom – Spacious second-floor bedroom with access to a shared bathroom featuring double vanities and a walk-in shower.
• Bunk Room for Kids – Two twin-over-full bunk beds with a nearby TV hangout space for movies and games.
• Open Living Area – Bright gathering space connecting kitchen, dining, and living areas.
• Fully Equipped Kitchen – Ideal for everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners.
• Coffee Bar – Pod and drip coffee makers, grinder, and starter coffee supplies.
• Everyday Convenience – Smart TVs, free Wi-Fi, and a full-size washer and dryer.

Distance to Airports:

• Panama City (ECP): 21 mi | 30 min
• Destin–Ft. Walton (VPS): 49 mi | 1 hr 20 min
• Pensacola (PNS): 95 mi | 1 hr 45 min

Please be advised that March 1 – April 19, a 7:00 PM curfew for unaccompanied minors under the age of 18 will be in effect in coordination with the Walton County Sheriff`s Office.

This policy applies to Seaside, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and the majority of communities along 30A, all of which are enforcing these Spring Break safety regulations in unison with local law enforcement.

Guests are responsible for ensuring all members of their party comply with community guidelines and local regulations.
PLEASE NOTE: WE DO NOT RENT TO STUDENT GROUPS, AGE OF PRIMARY RENTER MUST BE 23 OR OLDER AND RESIDING IN PROPERTY DURING STAY.

1. Smoking is NOT allowed. Evidence of smoking in the unit after guest departure will be subject to an additional cleaning fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.
2. People other than those noted in the booking may not stay overnight in the property. Any other person in the property is the sole responsibility of Guest.
3. All our properties are privately owned; property management and the owners are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. Property management and the homeowners are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises and recreational gear provided with the premises or others whom they invite to use the premise.
4. Keep the property and all furnishings in good order.
5. Only use appliances for their intended uses.
6. Bed linens and bath towels are included in the home. Please do not use rental houses linens at the beach or pool. Beach towels are provided in the home (one per person).
7. Please know we do not rent to student groups or to guests under the age of 23. Guest whose name is on the reservation must be present for the duration of the stay.
8. This IS NOT a pet friendly property. Evidence of pets in the unit after guest departure will be subject to a $300 fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.


*DEPARTURE CHECKLIST:
• Empty refrigerator of all perishables. Remove all garbage from the home and take to exterior trash bins.
• Load any dirty dishes in the dishwasher and begin the wash cycle (use dishwasher detergent).
• Do not strip beds, but DO collect all the used towels and place in the laundry room.
• Check all drawers and closets for any personal items.
• Return key to the kitchen counter.
• Turn off all lights and make sure exterior doors are locked. Make sure beach cruiser bikes are locked.
• Check out on time, no later than 10am CT firm. If you’re leaving prior to 10am CT please text 30A Sea Story at the number listed on your arrival details so the cleaning crew can enter the home. THANK YOU!

*Homes left in complete disarray will be subject to an additional cleaning fee. Listing sites will be provided with photographs.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

responses.response:
Thank you very much for the review, and we apologize for the mix-up in communications amongst our staff members relative to the handling of the chair. Rest assured that our maintenance team has ensured all the chair legs for the kitchen chairs are tight, and the broken chair has been replaced.

As far as the uninvited guests go, we treat the home for pests on a monthly basis, but every now and then nature finds a way in. In those rare instances, we are more than happy to re-treat the property at a time that is convenient our guests so long as they make us aware of the problem while they are in residence.

As far as parking goes, we advertise the home as having enough room for two vehicles to park side by side with no problem. From time to time, guests will ask if they can park three vehicles, and our answer is always that it really depends on the size of the vehicles in question and how they are parked. Three mid-sized sedans can fit, but it is tight. If you choose to park in this manner, we recommend parking in such a way that the driver-side of the outer vehicles is easily accessible. Accessing the vehicle in the middle typically requires moving one of the other vehicles.

That being said, since street parking in the neighborhood is NOT allowed, we generally recommend that guests with more than two vehicles in their party consider parking off, but along the side of North Orange Street, which is just outside the neighborhood.
